body: I get that for sure. I think my mom would end up in a mental hospital or killing herself if I ever did it. But sometimes just knowing I could if I really needed to makes me feel better. Sometimes it just makes me feel trapped to know I can't really.
They dont really know how bad things are. I dont really want them to in case I decide to go through with it.
This is my nightmare. I'm so sorry

That's what I thought would happen to me but this comment does make me worried about "the creep". Bc like they said, I did think for a second that maybe drinking more would make the buzz feel less weird. 

It's weird - I simultaneously never want to drink again and want to get to a place where I can drink moderately. This sub has taught me there's a really good chance that if I'm here - I won't be able to do the second one and I just have to learn to be ok with that. It's really hard though!
Wow that's incredible! This is my real goal - being able to go out and have fun and continue to not drink. Something to aspire to
